# FuelPro

> FuelPro is an all-in-one fuel station management platform. It gives fuel
> station owners and attendants a single system for point of sale, pump and
> tank inventory, M-PESA and card payments, invoicing, credit accounts,
> payroll, supplier management, regulatory compliance (EPRA, KRA eTIMS), and
> real-time analytics. It runs as an installable web app on any device.

## Product

- [Home](https://fuel-app-mobile.vercel.app/): Product overview and entry point.
- [Sign in](https://fuel-app-mobile.vercel.app/sign-in): Access an existing station account.
- [Sign up](https://fuel-app-mobile.vercel.app/sign-up): Create a station account and complete guided setup.

## Core capabilities

- Point of Sale: quick fuel sales, cart, cash/M-PESA/card payments, tax-compliant receipts.
- Sales Tracking: pump readings, shift sales, tank inventory, daily summaries.
- Stock Management: products, adjustments, transfers, counts, wastage, auto-reorders.
- Payments: M-PESA Daraja STK Push, Kopo Kopo, PayHero Kenya, live transaction feed.
- Credit & Invoicing: customer credit accounts, debt reminders, branded invoices.
- Payroll: employees, statutory deductions, payslip PDFs via WhatsApp/email.
- Compliance: country-aware tax (VAT, KRA eTIMS), permits, audit trail.
- Analytics: revenue trends, volumes, growth, predictions, CSV/PDF/Excel exports.

## Technical notes

- The app is a single-page application; in-app views live under the dashboard
  and require authentication. Authenticated views are marked noindex.
- API endpoints under /api/ are serverless functions and are disallowed to crawlers.
- Sitemap: https://fuel-app-mobile.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
